comparison.objective: Seal a springform pan before pouring batter; candidate performs connector depinning.
comparison.physical_skill: Seat a broad base, close an external clasp, and pour versus insert a narrow extraction tool around a recessed contact and depress two tangs.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a sealed pan without leakage or spill; candidate requires selective extraction without housing, crimp, or adjacent-terminal damage. Candidate numerical damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: The clasp-and-pour task does not test internal contact release or tool-maintained wire extraction.
